newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin rejects all bids in T-bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin rejects all bids in T-bill auction.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry on Wednesday rejected all bids in an auction of its 26-week treasury bills, the central bank said in a statement.
The statement said bids in the auction totalled 1.356 billion crowns, but it did not give further details and ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.

The auction was the first 26-week bill auction of the year. The longest maturity of T-bills auctioned this year was a tranche of 13-week T-bills on April 9 when average yield rose to 14.84 percent from 13.963 percent in the previous successful auction of similar T-bills on January 23.
The ministry does not set limit price on bids in auctions of state securities, nor does it set amount on the offer.
